Stormcloud
42% of base mana
Instant1 min cooldown
Summon a cloud above an enemy target's head for 15 sec, causing them to take 20% additional damage from your spells.

Using Torrential Wrath on an enemy affected by Stormcloud causes a Geyser to erupt beneath them, dealing 537+98.1 Points Per Level+FroP*.25 Frost damage and knocking them up slightly.
